description: One self-contained executable (smg.exe / smg): the game linked into the Vulkan host as one internalized object instead of smg_game.dll; no mods; no update check; reads only game.pak beside it and writes only saves/ and data/ beside it.
tests: pc.yml: builds on Windows and Linux, the SMG folder holds smg alone, and it starts and draws 300 frames (--start-check). game_object.py fails the build if any name besides the entry points stays visible.

description: No network or Nebula-service code in the single executable: the update check, vendor (DLSS/XeSS) downloads, the mods' net services and BoringSSL TLS and diagnostics-report sealing are not compiled in (Discord status stays: P0005); their settings rows are hidden. BoringSSL crypto stays for Wii SD save import (AES).
tests: pc.yml builds both platforms; their sources are absent from the build (generator expressions on NEBULA_GAME_OBJECT); a run writes nothing outside its folder (checked locally: find after a 60 s run).

description: AVX2 (x86-64-v3) only, on both platforms: no baseline build. A CPU without it gets a message and exit 1 instead of a missing sibling program (Windows) or an illegal instruction (Linux).
tests: pc.yml builds; the Linux check is compiled for baseline x86-64 and runs as the first constructor.
